title: CodeNEXT Draft Zoning Map Unveiled
summary:
*   Council members attended a press conference for the release of the initial CodeNEXT draft zoning map.
*   CodeNEXT is a significant effort to update the city's land use and zoning regulations.
*   This meeting was an informational event, and no official policy decisions or actions were taken by the Council.
transcript:
